title: Preparation — My Battles
description: Notice one situation that feels like a battle and write what makes it difficult.
preparation: Keep a notebook and one recent situation in mind.
intendedOutcome: Recognise the personal question that opens the learning journey.

title: Shloka Chanting
description: Join a guided chanting session with attention to pronunciation, rhythm and meaning.
preparation: Listen once to the assigned shloka before the session.
intendedOutcome: Chant the selected shloka with growing accuracy and reverence.

title: Contemplation Circle
description: Explore how the shloka illuminates choices in family, friendship and school.
preparation: Bring one observation from the week.
intendedOutcome: Relate the teaching to a real response in life.

title: Foundational Teaching
description: Study a connected group of chosen shlokas with an Acharya.
preparation: Read the shlokas and note questions.
intendedOutcome: Understand the teaching in its immediate and wider context.

title: Guided Reflection
description: Use prompts to examine the teaching in personal experience.
preparation: Find a quiet space and keep notes from the teaching nearby.
intendedOutcome: Move from remembered information toward examined understanding.

title: Application Experiment
description: Choose one teaching and apply it consciously in a current situation.
preparation: Name the situation and the response you usually make.
intendedOutcome: Test the usefulness of the teaching in daily action.

title: Complete-text Study
description: Study the sequence, language and vision of every shloka.
preparation: Read the assigned passage before the teaching.
intendedOutcome: Understand the passage within the complete movement of the Gita.

title: Inquiry Dialogue
description: Clarify questions and examine relationships among the teachings.
preparation: Bring questions from study and contemplation.

title: Extended Contemplation
description: Remain with one central teaching and observe its relevance in experience.
preparation: Select one teaching from the current passage.
intendedOutcome: Allow scriptural understanding to mature through sustained inquiry.

title: Listen to the Chapter
description: Listen attentively to pronunciation, metre and continuity.
preparation: Keep the chapter text open and follow silently.
intendedOutcome: Develop an accurate auditory model for chanting.

title: Guided Chanting Practice
description: Practise short sections with correction and repetition.
preparation: Warm up the voice and revisit the listening activity.
intendedOutcome: Chant the assigned section accurately and steadily.

title: Chapter Recitation
description: Integrate learned sections into a continuous chapter recitation.
intendedOutcome: Chant the complete chapter with rhythm, confidence and reverence.
